item.title: Auditable Event Occurred
item.description: Captures an auditable action for security or compliance tracking.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Measure Evaluated
item.description: Marks completion of all evaluations for a patient.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Measure Report Generated
item.description: Signals that a MeasureReport has been generated for a patient.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Patient Census Scheduled
item.description: Schedules retrieval of the current inpatient list.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Patient Event
item.description: Indicates that a patient admission or discharge has occurred.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Patient Lists Acquired
item.description: Provides a list of patient identifiers retrieved from a facility.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Payload Submitted
item.description: Confirms that a payload has been created and stored.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Ready for Validation
item.description: Notifies that a patient’s submission bundle is ready to be validated.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Ready to Acquire
item.description: Indicates when a data acquisition log is ready to be processed
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Report Scheduled
item.description: Announces that a reporting period has started for a tenant.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Resource Acquired
item.description: Represents a single FHIR resource retrieved from a facility.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Resource Evaluated
item.description: Contains a FHIR resource that has been evaluated for measures.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Resource Normalized
item.description: Indicates that a FHIR resource has been standardized.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Validation Complete
item.description: Conveys the result of validating a patient’s submission bundle.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Resource Normalized
item.description: Indicates that a FHIR resource has been standardized.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna

item.title: Report Status Updated
item.description: Emitted by various services to report the success or failure of specific reporting stages for a patient or a report.
item.author: Sean McIlvenna
